category: usenet provider (unlimited flat, three billing cycles)

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial on the plan page read; three paid cycles only.

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap is published; retrieval is by Usenet article over NNTP
per_object_cap.notes: an article size is a protocol convention, not a vendor number

retention.stated: 6570+ days of retention on every plan

egress.terms: Unlimited Usenet downloads on every plan

interface_detail: NNTP over SSL; the vendor page says to connect with your own newsreader
tooling: SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav over NNTP/TLS; any newsreader works because the protocol is the same everywhere, and no provider SDK is needed
chaining: A single flat plan in three cycles; useful as a deep-retention primary, with a block account on a different backbone as fill.
limits_note: USD 14.99 a month, USD 39.99 per 3 months, USD 139.99 per year.
binding_note: Volume is unlimited, so the 60-connection ceiling is the only technical bound stated.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the checkout was not opened, so the fields it asks for are behind a sign-up; a paid order is required before any access because no trial is offered.

reliability_note: The vendor says it keeps no history of downloaded articles; backbone is not stated on the page read.
confidence_note: Prices, connections and retention are from the vendor plan page read on 2026-11-03.

evidence.proved: the one-month plan still costs USD 14.99 and no free tier is published
the yearly plan still costs USD 139.99
the vendor still states that downloaded articles are not logged
evidence.quote: We do not keep logs of the articles you download.

evidence.proved: access is by NNTP over SSL in three paid billing cycles
evidence.quote: Connect with your own newsreader over an encrypted SSL connection. Choose a monthly, quarterly or yearly subscription.
